name: CKEditor5 Alignment Buttons
description: Exposes CKEditor 5 text alignment (left/center/right/justify) as four separate toolbar buttons instead of core's single alignment dropdown.
project_description: A simple module that provides the alignment buttons as standalone, without the need to use a dropdown button that Core provides. It defines a single CKEditor 5 plugin (ckeditor5_alignment_alignment) that reuses CKEditor 5's built-in alignment.Alignment plugin and surfaces four independent toolbar items - Align Left, Align Center, Align Right, Justify - each writing the corresponding core text-align-* CSS class. Post-installation you edit a text format/editor and add the buttons you want to the CKEditor 5 toolbar.
